evidence: The r3 exact-block search records searches for F/143 photos, elevations, and sections and reports no attributable street image or approved architectural elevation/section in accessible sources.

findings: Facade, opening rhythm, and entrance remain unverified and absent; a building-specific photo or elevation would be needed to raise this criterion materially.
